candidates.evidence: ADR-0197 (ratified 2026-08-17, GH #1092, built same-day PR #1097): the THIRD proof of the barrel-lazy-split pattern (dogfood-lazy GH#354 -> markdown-lazy GH#468 -> agent-admin-lazy ADR-0197) -- a public '.' barrel's STATIC class/tag re-export drags its whole module graph into every consumer's entry chunk regardless of use; fix = move static access to subpaths + add one memoized loadX() dynamic-import accessor on the barrel, gated by a Rolldown bundle-shape test. PR #1097 also strengthens the bundle-shape gate itself over the markdown-lazy precedent: agent-admin-lazy.bundle.test.ts's own comment names the gap -- a lazy accessor can still leak its arm into a STATIC SHARED chunk the entry imports eagerly (isEntry:false yet still loaded eagerly with the barrel), so 'absent from isEntry chunks' passes vacuously; the correct gated property is 'absent from the EAGER CLOSURE' (entry chunks + their transitive static imports), which is what agent-admin-lazy.bundle.test.ts's eager-closure computation (chunksOf's eager Set, walking imports) actually asserts. Checked 2026-08-17: patterns-table.md row 17 ('a heavy sub-component only some usages need -> lazy import() at the interaction point') is a DIFFERENT shape (internal lazy-import for an interior sub-component, ADR-0048's calendar-into-text-field-overlay) and does not cover a public barrel's STATIC re-export forcing bundling, nor the eager-closure bundle-test refinement; grep of every skills/*/references/*.md for moduleIds/bundle.test/rolldown/isEntry returns nothing anywhere -- both facets genuinely uncaptured.

candidates.evidence: ADR-0193's 2026-08-17 ratified amendment (GH #1077, verified via header + utterance) adds a SYNC READ surface scoped to the localStorage tier ONLY: SyncReadableStorageAdapter extends StorageAdapter with getSync/keysSync (per-verb mirrors of the async surface, same-tick reads over the SAME live backing store) -- rejecting a snapshot()-style warm-cache alternative as reintroducing the stale-in-memory-mirror failure mode this ADR's own base Alternatives already rejected. Capability expression is a NAMED interface extension + a narrowing factory return type (createLocalStorageAdapter narrows to SyncReadableStorageAdapter), NOT optional members on the base interface and NOT a runtime probe as primary -- the deliberate INVERSE of the data package's DataSource<T> optional-capability-probe idiom (ADR-0192 SPEC-R2), reasoned explicitly because sync-reads are a property of exactly ONE known tier the primary consumer constructs itself, a statically-known fact, not an arbitrary-source generic seam. Also amends the tier's role: after this lands, NO module in app touches localStorage directly (memory-store.ts's hydration migrates off its own hand-rolled prefix scan). Checked 2026-08-17: component-patterns/patterns-table.md row 35 (adr-0193, status:harvested via PR #1070) covers ONLY the base decision (async get/set/delete/keys, two tiers, cross-tab notify) -- it has no getSync/keysSync/SyncReadableStorageAdapter content; this is genuinely new, not a duplicate of the already-harvested base row. NOTE: filed under a synthetic id (adr-0193-amendment) rather than reusing adr-0193/harvest, so the existing harvested base-decision row (with its landed_in/status audit trail) is not clobbered by this add -- both facets of ADR-0193 now have their own tracked row.
